policy.name: Crystalline move-availability policy
policy.levelUp: Most recent generation's level-up list that exists for the species/form (Gen IX when it is in Scarlet/Violet, otherwise its latest game). Level 0 = learned on evolution, level 1 = starting moves.
policy.machine: A move is machine-legal if the species or a pre-evolution can learn it by TM/TR/tutor in ANY generation (the importer's behaviour); legal in older generations only is counted separately.
policy.egg: Egg moves are recorded, breeding is not implemented: out of scope, world assignments that rely on them are reported as conflicts.
policy.event: Event-only (S) and Let's Go / Virtual Console (V) sources are not learnable in-game.
policy.forms: A form uses its own Showdown learnset when it has one with a level-up list, otherwise Dex.learnset inherits changesFrom, then the base species.
policy.nonstandard: Moves with a Showdown isNonstandard flag (Past, Unobtainable, LGPE, CAP, Custom, Gmax, Future) are reported with every species that depends on them.

olderGenerationLevelUpDropped.note: Species/move pairs learnable by level-up in an older generation only (absent from the selected level-up list, TM/tutor list and egg list): not legal under the policy.

machineGenerations.note: machine = TM/TR/tutor from ANY generation (importer behaviour). 'older only' = no Gen IX M/T source and not in the selected level-up list.

nonstandardDependencies.note: Each entry lists the species whose level-up (levelUp), TM/tutor (machine) or egg list depends on a move Showdown flags isNonstandard. Species lists are space separated ids.
